english.title: Drunk and disorderly in a public place
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in a public place, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..), were guilty, while drunk, of disorderly behaviour
english.legislation: Contrary to section 91(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 1967.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

(i) This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DA06, the penalty within such an order was raised from £80 to £90 as from 01/07/13.
(ii) This offence although summary and non imprisonable has been deemed by the Home Secretary in S.I. 2000 / 1139 at para 4 as a PNC recordable offence.
(iii) See the CPS charging standards for this offence before preparing any charges.
